While some individuals may welcome extra income, employers could easily exploit this flexibility by making long hours an unspoken expectation rather than a genuine choice. Over time, this shift would likely increase healthcare costs, reduce family and civic engagement, and erode the labor protections that keep workplaces fair. Protecting reasonable work limits ultimately supports a more sustainable and equitable society.

Stance: -1
